questions.question: The chief priests and elders met in the courtyard of the high priest Caiaphas. What did they plot to do to Jesus?

answers.text: Arrest Him covertly and kill Him
Debate Him in front of the crowds

questions.question: When a woman poured perfume on Jesus at Simon the Leper's home, what did Jesus say she had done for Him?

answers.text: Anointed Him as king of Israel
Refreshed Him for the road ahead

questions.question: After a woman poured perfume on Jesus in Bethany, what did Jesus promise about her?

answers.text: Her deed would be told wherever the gospel is preached
Her jar would be paid back to her many times over
Her name would be written on the walls of the temple

questions.question: Judas Iscariot offered to hand Jesus over to the chief priests. How many pieces of silver did they set out for him?
